v1alpha1ExecCommandResponse.description:
ExecCommandResponse is one message in the server->client stream. Only
exit_code terminates the stream; error may be sent (typically followed by
exit_code) without ending the exchange.

uid.description: uid is the microvm identifier, as used by MicroVM.GetMicroVM/DeleteMicroVM.

cwd.description: cwd is the working directory; empty means the guest-agent's cwd.

env.description: env entries are added to (and override) the guest-agent's environment.

shell.description: shell runs "sh -c <cmd + args joined>" instead of a direct exec.

user.description: user, if set, runs the command as that guest system user.

timeoutSeconds.description: timeout_seconds bounds the run; 0 means unbounded.

hasStdin.description: has_stdin tells the server to expect streamed stdin messages.

v1alpha1ExecStart.description:
ExecStart describes the microvm to target and the command to run, mirroring
the guest-agent's own exec request fields.
